# property-testing-openapi

Namespace: `Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\OpenApi`.

Purpose: create reproducible, JSON-compatible OpenAPI request cases and turn
them into PSR-7 requests before an explicit transport is called.

Public API:
- `SchemaArbitraryCompiler::compile(array $schema): ArbitraryInterface`
- `RequestCaseArbitrary::forOperation(Operation): ArbitraryInterface`
- `RequestMaterializer::materialize(Operation, array $case): RequestInterface`
- `TransportInterface::send(RequestInterface): ResponseInterface`
- `CallableTransport` and `Psr15Transport` execute an explicit transport boundary.
- `SecurityRequirement`, `CredentialsProviderInterface`, `CredentialsUnavailable`,
  and `SecuritySelector` model OR alternatives and AND schemes without putting
  secrets in generated cases; an empty requirement object selects anonymous
  credentials without calling the provider.
- `Credentials` applies secret headers/query/cookies at materialization time;
  pass the selected credentials as the optional third argument to
  `RequestMaterializer::materialize`.
- `NegativeRequestCaseArbitrary::forOperation(Operation)` removes one required
  request component and records `misuse.kind = 'missing-required'`.
- `NegativeRequestCaseArbitrary::typeMismatchForOperation(Operation)` replaces
  one required scalar integer/number/boolean/null parameter with an invalid wire
  value and records `misuse.kind = 'type'`; both methods throw
  `UnsupportedGeneration` when their mutation cannot be constructed.
- `NegativeRequestCaseArbitrary::enumMismatchForOperation(Operation)` replaces
  one required scalar enum parameter with a value outside the enum and records
  `misuse.kind = 'enum'`.
- `NegativeRequestCaseArbitrary::constMismatchForOperation(Operation)` replaces
  one required scalar `const` parameter with a different value and records
  `misuse.kind = 'const'`.
- `NegativeRequestCaseArbitrary::boundaryMismatchForOperation(Operation)`
  replaces one required integer/number parameter with a wire value just outside
  its `minimum`/`maximum` bound (boolean exclusive bounds honoured) and records
  `misuse.kind = 'boundary'`.
- `UnsupportedGeneration` for unsupported schema/body/parameter input.

`RequestCaseData` has `operationKey`, separate path/query/headers/cookies maps,
an optional `{mediaType, encoding: 'json', value}` body, and `misuse: null`.
It must contain only JSON-compatible values and never secrets or PSR-7 objects.
Required parameters and request bodies are always generated. Optional parameters
and JSON bodies are generated as both present and absent branches.
Object generation supports bounded `minProperties`, `maxProperties`, and
boolean or schema-valued `additionalProperties`.
The constructive `not` subset supports `const`, `enum`, and `type` exclusions;
other negative assertions fail closed.
